title: The Blaschka Object Network — Digitized Correspondence Corpus Register
scope: Digitized primary-source correspondence corpora that can be downloaded or searched directly and ingested into a research corpus. A collection-level digital surrogate is distinguished from item-level content claims: dates, correspondents and holding institutions may be secure even when individual letters have not yet been content-coded.

status_vocabulary.direct_digitized_primary_corpus: A substantial primary-source corpus is openly digitized with page images and/or downloadable OCR/text.
status_vocabulary.metadata_only_until_read: Collection identity and dates are verified, but letter content must be read before topic claims are assigned.
status_vocabulary.metadata_date_conflict: The displayed archival label and structured metadata date disagree; the manuscript/page label remains the authority until image review.
status_vocabulary.part_level_pdf_mirror: An individual BHL correspondence part has a separately downloadable PDF and persistent record on Zenodo, deposited by Plazi from BHL.

corpora.title: Rudolf Blaschka letters to Walter Deane
corpora.creator: Rudolf Blaschka
digital_features: table of contents with individually dated correspondence parts
part-level Plazi/Zenodo PDF mirrors for multiple BHL parts
corpora.corpus_scale_note: BHL's Rudolf Blaschka creator index exposes 80 chapters/articles/treatments, dominated by the dated correspondence parts in this collection. The item table of contents runs from 23 October 1895 through 10 December 1927 and also contains notes, postcards, extracts and some correspondence to or from G. L. Goodale and other participants.
corpora.content_guard: BHL describes the Blaschka-to-Deane letters as botanical and personal. Logistics, patronage, workshop practice, regulation or model-production topics must be coded from the individual pages rather than inferred from the date span.

part_level_mirrors.relationship: individual PDFs derived from BHL correspondence parts
part_level_mirrors.guard: The Zenodo records inherit BHL part metadata and do not independently resolve BHL date conflicts. They are useful as persistent downloadable part-level surrogates, not as a new archival authority.

research_use: cross-walk against Harvard Ware correspondence and workshop business records
comparison of private botanical/personal correspondence with formal business letters
search for model-production, plant supply, travel, shipment, payment, war/postwar disruption and institutional relations after 1895
stable part-level PDF citation through BHL part IDs and Zenodo DOIs

ingest_recommendation.rule: Preserve BHL's raw metadata and archival page label separately; do not overwrite date anomalies during ingest. Treat Zenodo as a persistent part-level surrogate, not as an independent date authority.
